Maria (Partnerships): Quick kickoff 3: Orbita wants a tight onboarding for their SI engineers. Aim: first PoC + marketplace listing in ~4 weeks. Who picks up the checklist?
Aj (GTM): Ill own checklist + PR plan. Need a co-branded one-pager and a concise demo runbook.
Devon (Solutions): I can build the runbook. Requesting staging creds and the demo route (which model + prompt set).
Eli (Training): Ill scope a short SI badge exam (15 min) and a slide deck. Do we want proctored or self-serve? :thinking_face: 
Maria (Partnerships): Start self-serve. Badge lives on partner portal. Include two labs: one hitting Redwood hosted demo and one local deploy.
Sam (Eng): Staging endpoint: `staging-orbita.redwood.ai/models/demo-v2`. Opening access ticket for Orbita engineers now.
Zoe (Marketing): Ill draft co-branded one-pager template. Who can supply Orbita logo + a short partner quote? :memo: 
Aj (GTM): Orbita also asked for an AWS/GCP marketplace checklist. Eng, can you confirm canonical package artifact and billing hook?
Sam (Eng): Marketplace requires signed manifest + meter endpoint. Test billing snippet we use for partners: 
```
POST /billing/event
Host: billing-staging.redwood.ai
Body: {"partner":"orbita","usage_units":42}
```
Sam (Eng): Send contract contact and Ill wire the auths.
Devon (Solutions): Minimal PoC prompt set: short-answer summarization, chat follow-ups, embeddings similarity search. Ill clean the pack and share a link.
Eli (Training): Proposed training flow: 20m product overview; 30m hands-on lab (staging); 15m troubleshooting; 15m quiz -> badge. I can also record a <30m on-demand video + slides.
Maria (Partnerships): Draft timeline suggestion: Week 0 kickoff + SOW; Week 1 access + training + one-pager; Week 2 PoC runs + marketplace prep; Week 3 QA + cert issuance; Week 4 marketplace listing + joint announce. Thoughts? :calendar: 
Aj (GTM): Sounds doable if Eng can grant staging access by EOW. Also want PR/announce plan ready by Week 3.
Sam (Eng): Prioritizing access ticket and marketplace manifest template. ETA EOD Friday. tagging @deploy-bot to create env.
deploy-bot: env-create request received: workspace=orbita-staging, requested-by=@Sam, status=pending
Zoe (Marketing): For the joint announcement recommend a short technical case study + partner quote. Ill draft and share Tue.
Devon (Solutions): Recommend adding an automated eval suite to monitor model quality during the PoC. Ill place it under `partners/orbita/evals`.
Eli (Training): Partnerships, can you send me 3 SI role bullets (implementation engineer, solution architect, sales engineer) to tailor the badge quiz?
Maria (Partnerships): Will DM the role bullets and Orbita contact info. Scheduling 30m kickoff with Orbita tomorrow 11am PT and will send invite.
Aj (GTM): Quick assignment recap: Aj = checklist + PR plan; Devon = demo runbook + eval suite; Sam = staging + marketplace manifest; Eli = training + badge; Zoe = co-branded assets + announcement.
Maria (Partnerships): Add any blockers here. :thumbsup:
